name: Documentation update
description: Write and render a clear documentation update with accurate prerequisites, examples, safety notes, and link evidence.

outcomes.description: A named audience can follow the documented task from prerequisite through expected result.
The changed documentation renders cleanly and leaves a redacted closure record.

prerequisites.description: The audience, task, prerequisite knowledge, and success signal are explicit.
prerequisites.check: State what a beginner should be able to do after reading.

prerequisites.description: The behavior being documented is verified or clearly labeled as an example.
prerequisites.check: Compare claims with a safe current source before writing.

lanes.objective: Outline audience, task, prerequisites, example path, and safety notes.
Write the scoped documentation in plain language with accurate examples.
Render the change and check links, headings, terminology, and safety notes.

qualityGates.description: Instructions and examples match an observed safe behavior or state their limits plainly.
A beginner can follow the task with clear prerequisites, steps, and expected result.
The preview, links, headings, and navigation checks pass without private content.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response to verify documentation.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; use public or safe existing evidence instead.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Document or trigger billing, account security, destructive data, or live financial behavior as a test step.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Documentation examples must remain safe and reversible.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Keep the previous rendered documentation and return to its last known-good integration point if a claim or link is wrong.
rescueSteps: Capture the failed claim, link, or render summary.
Preserve the scoped text patch for review.
Mark the update abandoned when the source behavior cannot be verified.
stopConditions: The documented behavior is unknown or contradictory.
An example needs private or secret data.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit credentials, tokens, private paths, and private dashboard content.
Use synthetic examples and safe route names.
